ns2:section.sectionText: CREDIT RISK. An introduction to the growing field of credit risk analysis. Analyzes approaches for evaluating default risk, including structural models, reduced-form models, hybrid models, ratings-based models, and credit-scoring models. Discusses major types of credit derivatives, such as total return swaps, credit-default swaps, credit-linked notes, and credit-sensitive notes. Registration restricted to MSFs and MBAs.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS:Finance: International-UIUC or MBA:Bus Administration -UIUC.
